BIADA allots 120 plots at Bihta industrial park

The Bihar Industrial Area Development Authority has allotted 120 industrial plots at its Bihta park, with food processing and textile units bagging most of the allotted space.

Officials said the allotments, cleared after scrutiny of 210 applications, are expected to bring in proposed investments of nearly Rs 900 crore and generate around 8,000 direct jobs.

The park, spread over 1,670 acres near the upcoming Bihta airport, already hosts units manufacturing ethanol, packaged foods and plastic goods.

Industry bodies said reliable power and the new land allotment policy had improved investor response compared to previous rounds.

BIADA said water supply and common effluent treatment works at the park would be commissioned before the new units begin trial production.
